acceptance_criteria.description: tests/contract/package.test.ts parses and its three tests pass on the current Windows host.

closed_decisions: In the regex matching a Windows pnpm command shim, remove the invalid escaped double quote inside the negated character class while preserving the literal backslash after %~dp0 and the .cjs capture.
Do not redesign the resolver or alter any other test behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit any other file, alter production behavior, enable a shell, commit, push, open a PR, or touch Jira.
objective: Correct the invalid Unicode regular-expression escape in the Windows pnpm shim parser so the package contract test can load and run.
